title: Blood Trial
summary: Ha-Jun claims the Ring of Hollow Blood and is pulled into the Blood Trial Mindscape to battle the Shadow of the Sovereign. Subjugating the crimson sea, he unlocks Blood Forging—just as an elite Demon Hunter cuts through the sealed stone doors to execute him.

panels.shot: macro antique silver ring ruby heartbeat
panels.action: Extreme macro on the antique silver Ring of Hollow Blood; its central ruby tear pulses with an internal rhythmic crimson heartbeat glow.

panels.shot: kuro grave warning perched on altar
panels.action: Kuro perches on the altar rim, voice low: 'Ring of Hollow Blood. Yeh Basic Relic hai, par iski qeemat tazi zindagi ka khoon hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Dhyan se. Yeh relic taze khoon ki qeemat mangti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun extends his bare left hand, index finger hovering a millimeter above the cold silver band with steady resolve.
The instant skin touches silver, multiple razor micro-needles erupt from the inner band, sinking deep into Ha-Jun's ring finger.
Ha-Jun winces sharply, teeth bared: 'Agh! Yeh toh ungli ko kaat raha hai!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh ungli mein ghus raha hai...!

panels.action: The central ruby drinks a thread of scarlet blood through the silver filigree, glowing with vivid crimson demonic luminescence.
The silver ring contracts smoothly, resizing itself to fit Ha-Jun's ring finger like an inseparable second skin.
A visible shockwave of bright scarlet and deep violet mana explodes up Ha-Jun's left arm, illuminating his arteries through his skin.
Ha-Jun's eyes glaze over; the physical chamber blurs away as his consciousness is ripped into a metaphysical blood dimension.
Ha-Jun stands atop the surface of an endless crimson blood ocean beneath a pitch-black sky without sun or stars.

dialogue.text: Rakt-Sagar... Sovereign ke antarman ki gehrai.

panels.action: Standing 20 paces away across the blood water is a towering shadow figure clad in full sovereign armor, resembling Ha-Jun's dark twin.

dialogue.text: Uske samne khada tha... uska hi andhera roop.

panels.action: The Shadow speaks with multiple echoing demonic voices: 'Tum ring pehente ho... par kya tum iske malik ho, ya sirf shaitan ka khana?'

dialogue.text: Kya tum malik ho... ya sirf ek kamzor shikar?

panels.action: The Shadow raises its hand: The crimson ocean erupts as one thousand razor-sharp blood daggers form and float in the air.
All one thousand crimson blades aim their needle tips directly at Ha-Jun's neck, hovering inches away from his skin.

dialogue.text: Apna irada saabit karo... warna apne hi khoon mein doob jao.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's violet eyes blaze with fury: 'Main saat saal tak zaleel hua... taaki aaj apne hi dimaag ke andar maar diya jaaun?!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MAIN KISI KE AAGE NAHI JHUKUNGA!!

panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward and stomps his boot hard onto the surface of the blood sea, releasing a royal purple shockwave.
The purple shockwave sweeps across the blades; all one thousand blood daggers instantly freeze motionless under Ha-Jun's absolute command.
Ha-Jun sweeps his right arm horizontally: All one thousand blood blades whip around 180 degrees, pointing directly at the Shadow!
The Shadow reflection smiles with dark, ancient royal approval: 'Shabash... yahi hai Sovereign ka saccha ghamand.'

dialogue.text: Shabash. Tum wakai is takht ke kaabil ho.

panels.action: Ha-Jun clenches his fist: The thousand blades converge in a crimson whirlwind, fusing into a colossal 30-foot Blood Halberd.
Ha-Jun thrusts the massive blood halberd straight through the Shadow's armored chest in a blinding explosion of scarlet mist.
The entire blood dimension fractures into a million geometric glass shards, dissolving into brilliant white light.
Snap back: Ha-Jun blinks back into physical reality, chest heaving and sweat dripping from his chin onto the stone altar.
A royal amethyst system screen chimes: [BLOOD TRIAL PASSED] | [RELIC 2/10: RING OF HOLLOW BLOOD BOUND] | [SKILL: BLOOD FORGING (RANK E)].

panels.shot: blood forging dagger in hand macro
panels.action: Ha-Jun tests his new skill: A droplet of blood from his palm elongates and solidifies into a razor-sharp, crystalline red dagger in his grip.
Kuro flaps his dark wings with delight: 'Khoon se hathiyar banane ki taqat! Yeh blade kabhi kharab nahi hogi!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Kamaal! Khoon se banna hathiyar kabhi nahi tootega!

panels.action: Suddenly, the 10-ton sealed stone slab at the chamber entrance shakes under heavy concussive strikes from the outside: *THUD!! THUD!!*
A high-frequency blade of glowing silver mana cuts through the solid 3-foot thick stone slab like a hot knife through butter.
Kuro's feathers bristle in genuine alarm: 'Silver mana... YEH HUMAN DEMON HUNTER HAI! Wo basement tak pahunch gaye!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Silver mana... Demon Hunter aa gaya hai!

panels.shot: hunter in white coat entrance cliffhanger
panels.action: The stone slab explodes inward; stepping through the dust cloud is an elite Hunter in a white tactical coat wielding twin silver blades: 'Target confirmed. Shaitan ka waris, Kang Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Target confirmed. Shaitan ka waris, Kang Ha-Jun.
